results.content: Thanks to its Super Silent enclosure and new vibration-isolating frame, the unit operates extremely quietly - ideal for noise-sensitive environments. The fully automatic B-CONTROL MICRO control system with color display enables intuitive operation. The integrated B-DRAIN system reduces energy consumption during condensate drainage. All components are designed for long service life and continuous operation. Built for long life and continuous duty, the MINI-VERTICUS reflects over 70 years of BAUER compressor expertise, with premium build quality and modular expandability. Compressor block Our compressor blocks are based on decades of experience and development. An efficient air cooling system with large coolers and finned cylinders ensures optimal cooling. Robust industrial roller bearings, pressure lubrication, and fine oil filters minimize wear. Dynamically balanced drive units ensure smooth operation and long maintenance intervals. Purification System P 41 The P 41 Purification System with additional oil and water separator as well as pressure-retaining non-return valve ensures reliable breathing air in accordance with DIN EN 12021:2014¹ when using original BAUER filter cartridges. A type-tested, sealed final pressure safety valve ensures high operational safety. B-SAFE B-SAFE safety filling chamber ensures a high degree of personal safety for the operating staff. As a result of filling accidents arising from exploding breathing air cylinders, explosion protection is now standard or even mandatory in many countries. B-SAFE is the alternative to expensive protective measures for compressor rooms while still providing the maximum legally required safety for the operator.
